market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver is currently around $30/oz. To reach $120 by June 2026 would require a 4x surge in ~14 months, far beyond historical precedents (all-time high ~$50). No plausible fundamental catalyst supports such a spike, making the true probability orders of magnitude lower than the market’s 6.6%.
evidence_points: Silver last traded near $30, needing a 300% gain to hit $120.
CME silver futures all-time high is ~$50, set in 2011.
No impending supply shock, hyperinflation, or structural change justifies a 4x move in 14 months.
